_meta.name: higgsfield_ugc_avatar_framework
_meta.purpose: Field-by-field schema for building a hyperrealistic UGC avatar image prompt for the Higgsfield MCP. Default model is soul_2 (Higgsfield Soul 2.0) for UGC/portrait/character; use nano_banana_pro for max-quality or on-image-text frames. Fill every field, then flatten in block order into one descriptive paragraph of 150-400 words. Block 1 and Block 3 are LOCKED once defined and must be reused verbatim across every image of the same avatar — that is what keeps the character recognizably the same person.
_meta.how_to_use: 1) Copy the `template` object. 2) Fill each field, choosing from `options` where provided or writing free text. 3) Flatten using `flatten_order` into a single paragraph. 4) Pass that paragraph as `prompt` to generate_image with model soul_2 (or nano_banana_pro). 5) Save the filled `block_3_subject` object as the avatar's reusable identity card. NOTE: for true reuse prefer Higgsfield's native identity tools — train a Soul (show_characters action=train, 5-20 photos) and pass the returned soul_id with model soul_2, or save a Reference Element. The text identity card below is the fallback when no Soul/Element is used.

identity_strategy.soul_trained: show_characters action=train (5-20 photos, ~10 min) -> soul_id -> generate_image model=soul_2 with soul_id. Most identity-faithful, one person per generation.
identity_strategy.reference_element: show_reference_elements action=create from one image -> reusable reference. Works across many models, allows multiple subjects in one shot.
identity_strategy.one_off: Generate from text only, then reuse the first approved image's job_id as a reference (medias role=image) on every later shot so the face holds.

block_1_quality_style._lifespan: LOCKED across all generations of all avatars in the UGC style
block_1_quality_style._why: Mixing rendering styles between shots is the fastest way to break the illusion that two images show the same real person.
block_1_quality_style.texture_rendering: ultra-detailed lifelike skin with visible pores, realistic individual hair strands, precise fabric weave
block_1_quality_style.lighting_signature: natural smartphone HDR, sharp focus, slight digital sharpening
block_1_quality_style.imperfection_layer: subtle real-camera imperfections: faint sensor noise, mild lens softness at edges, true-to-life color (not over-saturated)

options.ugc_selfie: selfie photograph, close-up, eye level or slightly high angle, slight wide-angle lens distortion, arm's-length framing
options.talking_head: portrait, head and shoulders, eye level, 85mm portrait compression, shallow depth of field
options.full_lifestyle: full body shot, three-quarter framing, eye level, environmental context visible

block_2_composition.framing_notes: free text: how much headroom, where the eyes sit, any handheld tilt

block_3_subject._lifespan: IDENTITY LOCKED forever; only clothing/pose/expression/accessories change per scene
block_3_subject._why: These fields are the avatar's identity card. Reusing them verbatim is what lets one avatar appear in dozens of videos as the same recognizable person.

physical_build.skin_tone: free text (e.g., warm light-brown, golden undertone)

hair.color: free text (e.g., dark brown with subtle caramel highlights)
hair.default_style: free text (e.g., center part, soft face-framing layers)

face.shape: free text (e.g., oval with soft jawline)
face.complexion: free text (e.g., clear, dewy, light freckles across nose)
face.eyes: free text (color, shape, lashes — e.g., warm brown, almond, full natural lashes)
face.eyebrows: free text (e.g., full, softly arched, natural)
face.nose: free text (e.g., straight bridge, refined tip)
face.mouth: free text (e.g., medium-full lips, natural rose tone)
face.distinguishing_marks: free text (e.g., small beauty mark above left lip) — keep these consistent, they are strong identity anchors

changes_per_scene.clothing: free text (e.g., oversized cream knit sweater)
changes_per_scene.pose: free text (e.g., holding phone at arm's length, head slightly tilted)
changes_per_scene.expression: free text (e.g., warm relaxed half-smile, eyes to camera)
changes_per_scene.accessories: free text (e.g., small gold hoop earrings) — keep minimal for UGC realism

block_4_foreground._why: Clutter reads as a staged set, not a real person's phone video.
block_4_foreground.props: free text, 0-2 items (e.g., a phone in hand, a ceramic coffee mug)

block_5_background._why: Background lighting must match Block 1's smartphone aesthetic, or a studio-clean background behind a 'selfie' instantly looks fake.
block_5_background.setting: free text (e.g., sunlit bedroom, soft white bedding, plant in corner)
block_5_background.lighting: free text consistent with Block 1 (e.g., soft morning window light, warm)
block_5_background.depth_of_field: free text (e.g., gently blurred background, subject in sharp focus)
block_5_background.key_elements: free text, the 1-3 things actually visible behind the subject

settings._verify: These are live-verified defaults; confirm exact ranges with models_explore action=get before relying on them. Tool: generate_image. Pass the flattened paragraph as `prompt`; set model + params at the top level of params.

nano_banana_pro.label: Google Nano Banana Pro — max quality, on-image text, diagrams, one-off refs

settings.media_rule: Pass references as medias:[{role:'image', value:'<media_id or job_id>'}]. Never pass a raw URL — import web URLs first with media_import_url; upload local files with media_upload_widget (Apps UI) or media_upload -> PUT bytes -> media_confirm.
settings.cost_preflight: Set params.get_cost=true to return the credit cost WITHOUT submitting a job. Use before any generation the user has not pre-approved.
settings.no_polling: There is no job_status tool. generate_image returns a job id; render it with job_display (one id per call). Do not loop a poll step.

negative_guidance: soul_2 and nano_banana_pro are positive-prompt driven, so steer away from artifacts by adding counter-language to the relevant block: plastic/airbrushed skin, over-saturated color, doll-like symmetry, mismatched lighting between subject and background, extra fingers, warped accessories, studio-perfect backdrop behind a casual selfie. Example counter-language: 'natural asymmetric features, real skin texture, not airbrushed, true-to-life color'.
